A LOOK INSIDE THE AI

Model lab.

A real learned classifier, with a deliberately small and transparent task.

Training notebook
PIXELS → CLASS PROBABILITIES

Multiclass logistic regression

A 32 × 48 grayscale image becomes 1,536 pixel values. Learned weights produce probabilities for an aligned cap, missing cap, or tilted cap. The controller then applies your confidence threshold.

YOUR AUTOMATION PROJECT

From image to action.

A practical guide to the system, the experiments, and the code.

Download project
PROJECT 01 / SMART MANUFACTURING

Build a line that can
see, decide, and sort.

This software simulation connects computer vision to an automatic sorting sequence. You control the virtual production conditions and inspect what the model decided.

01

Detect & capture

A virtual sensor triggers a synthetic camera image for each arriving bottle.

02

Predict

The model uses image pixels to estimate probabilities for three cap conditions.

03

Actuate

The controller latches the route to that bottle’s ID and switches the virtual diverter.

04

Record

The log retains the decision, probabilities, settings, and final sorting state.

Try these experiments

  1. Run a baseline

    Start the conveyor at 1× with 25% defects. Watch each inspection and its sorting route.

  2. Challenge the model

    Send a missing-cap or tilted-cap bottle. Compare its known condition with the prediction.

  3. Make the camera struggle

    Increase lighting disturbance, then compare live accuracy and the review count.

  4. Change the threshold

    Raise minimum confidence. Investigate the trade-off between automatic decisions and manual review.

  5. Export your evidence

    Save the CSV and calculate acceptance, rejection, review, and misclassification rates.
